sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - OP-SKS is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I've got a new order from a client who's apparently a former hunter. You into hunting yourself? If you are, you'd probably get along with him... Though I can't tell you who he is. You understand - anonymity is essential in this line of work. He needs a modernized Simonov carbine with a suppressor and an optic. It also needs a magazine with at least 20-round capacity, ergonomics at or above 35, and combined recoil below 350. I've already prepared the carbine. The rest is up to you."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an OP-SKS to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"You finished it rather quickly. Impressive."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
OP-SKS specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 35 or greater ergonomics
- 350 or less recoil
- 600 or greater sighting range
- 6 kg or less in weight
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 20
- A silencer

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard OP-SKS from Jaeger LL1.

- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
